query: UPDATE agents SET vm_snapshot_dir = $2, vm_snapshot_full_interval = $3, vm_snapshot_timeout_seconds = $4, vm_snapshot_default_limit_bytes = $5, vm_snapshot_selection = COALESCE($6, agents.vm_snapshot_selection) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING vm_snapshot_dir, vm_snapshot_full_interval, vm_snapshot_timeout_seconds, vm_snapshot_default_limit_bytes, vm_snapshot_selection AS "vm_snapshot_selection: VmSelectionMode"
